paragraphs: Rav Chinena son of Rav Ika. Beitzah 28b and Ketubot 61b have in that matter Rav Chanina; so too Avodah Zarah 29a and Niddah 52a. There, 47b: Rav Chinena. Makkot 21a has in that matter Rav Nachman son of Rav Ika, an error [source ע״ס]. Niddah 45a has Rav Chiyya son of Rav Ika, certainly a scribal error. Jerusalem Taanit, chapter 1, halakhah 3: R. Chanina bar Yaka; also Jerusalem Berakhot 9:2:24 [received HaRoeh, halakhah 3]. In that matter in Bereshit Rabbah, end of section 13: R. Chanina bar Izka. Jerusalem Talmud, Kelal Gadol, and end of chapter 1 of Yevamot: R. Chanina Baroka, in R. Yehudah's name. Apparently they are all one. Jerusalem Talmud, HaMaddir, halakhah 7: in R. Yehudah's name. HaRoeh, Berakhot 58b: Rav Pappa and Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua met Rav Chanina son of Rav Ika and recited over him “Blessed is He who has apportioned of His wisdom to those who fear Him,” and “Who has kept us alive.” He said, “I consider you equal to six hundred thousand Israelites,” and recited over them those two blessings and “the One who knows secrets.” They told him, “Are you so wise?” They set their eyes on him, and he died. R. Chinena bar Ika teaches it thus, while Rav Zevid teaches it thus: Berakhot 25b. Rav Ika son of Rav Chanina; see there.
